thread:
The Real Cost of Running a Side Project (Honest Line-Item Breakdown)

Quick thread 🧵
For most side projects the bill is small.
Often nothing while you build on free tiers, then a few dollars a month once you want it always-on with your own domain.
Compute is the biggest cash line, a domain is roughly a dollar a month billed yearly, and a small database adds a few dollars only if you need one.
The cost that actually stings is your time.
